properties.description: TA-10.3 'DLQ' (P2): dlq_count > 0. The modern criteria shape measures the summarized count column, so literal GreaterThan 0 fires on >=1 dlq_count event in the last 5 min and stays silent when the window is empty (count = 0). Links to dashboard 'Job health' (id f1c8ca79-7c78-4aad-a512-6051a3bfb327, docs/dashboards/job-health.json). dev: informational (launch traffic is synthetic)

allOf.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'dlq_count' and timestamp >= ago(5m)
| summarize count()
